# Website Fixtures

Small, synthetic, locally served website fixtures for deterministic crawler, browser, extraction, and validation tests belong here. Fixtures must not reproduce third-party brands, copy, assets, or complete compositions.

`site/` is the synthetic Northstar Studio fixture served by the Compose `fixture-website` service. It includes home, pricing, services, about, contact, a blog index, three articles sharing one layout, `robots.txt`, a sitemap, and an intentionally invalid document at `/malformed/`. The brand, copy, and visual treatment were authored solely for this repository.
